[[File:Czechtitle.png | thumb | right | alt=A shield-shaped graphic divided into blue, white, and red sections outlined with a yellow border on a white background | A shield emblem with the colors of the Czech flag for the 1959-60 Czechoslovak First League season]]
Statistics of [[Czechoslovak First League]] in the 1959–60 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[FC Hradec Králové|Spartak Hradec Králové]] won the championship. [[Michal Pucher]] was the league's top scorer with 18 goals.<ref>{{cite book|first=Luboš|last=Jeřábek|title=Český a československý fotbal - lexikon osobností a klubů|publisher=Grada Publishing|language=Czech|year=2007|location=Prague, Czech Republic|isbn=978-80-247-1656-5|page=231}}</ref>
